title: Claude Code settings and managed settings
description: The Claude Code CLI settings schema plus the settings read by Claude Desktop. For permitted settings file locations, see https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference#settings-index.

browserExternalPageTools.description: Managed Desktop policy. Disable Claude's tools on external pages in the Browser pane. Both values are case-insensitive. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference#browserexternalpagetools.

disableBrowserExternalNavigation.description: Managed Desktop policy. Block external browsing in the Browser pane. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference#disablebrowserexternalnavigation.

disableDesktopLocalSessions.description: Managed Desktop policy. Prevent Claude Code sessions from running on the device. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference#disabledesktoplocalsessions.

disableMobileSimulatorTools.description: Managed Desktop policy. Turn off Claude's tools in the iOS Simulator pane. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference#disablemobilesimulatortools.

disableRemotePreviewScripts.description: Managed Desktop policy. Prevent scripts from running in HTML previews from SSH and WSL sessions. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference#disableremotepreviewscripts.

sshHostAllowlist.description: Managed Desktop policy. Allow SSH sessions only to hosts matching these case-insensitive patterns. An empty list disables SSH sessions and null leaves the list unset. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference#sshhostallowlist.
